topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out that my apartment building is converting to condos. It’s a significant change, but not entirely unexpected in this neighborhood. I’m taking the time to understand what this means for my lease and any options I might have. The management promised to send over a detailed package with all the information. In the meantime, I’m keeping an open mind and weighing my choices carefully. It’s a good opportunity to reconsider my living situation, whether that means staying on as a condo owner or looking for a new place.
